_comment: Per-gate assertion floors, enforced by qa/run-all.mjs. Raise a number deliberately when
checks are added. Never lower one to make a red build green: a falling tally means
coverage was removed, which is the only thing this file exists to catch.
The per-gate floors are the point. A total-only floor cannot see one gate losing ten
checks while another gains ten, which is exactly how coverage quietly moves out of the
place that needed it. CI keeps its own ASSERTION_BASELINE on the total as a second net.
